issues.desc: index.json priority field is "P2" — a non-standard value. The Lattice framework (CLAUDE.md story_create + gate logic) expects canonical values "high"/"medium"/"low". A non-canonical priority may cause gate mis-classification, skip auto-elevated risk-signal logic, or be misread by future tooling. Should be set to the intended canonical value (likely "medium").

background.md Conversational Texture section references "task #9 in this session\u2019s task list" — a session-private enumeration that has no referent for an independent reader. A new reader cannot determine what task #9 is or what list it belongs to. Should be replaced with a self-contained description of the motivation (e.g., the ledger unblocking goal already stated elsewhere in the background).

User-value bullet #2 (LLM usage ledger finally captures real token data for codex/gemini) overpromises relative to this story scope. The story explicitly excludes usage-ledger adapters (codex.ts/gemini.ts), so after this story lands the ledger still reports 0 tokens. The story unblocks real-capture but does not complete it. Recommend rewriting that bullet to say: unblocks real token capture (adapter follow-up required) to avoid product-acceptance confusion at DONE.
